defect_classification.title: Legitimate Zero-Return Value (0.0) Treated as Missing Data via Python Boolean OR Fallback
defect_classification.defect_mechanism: Python evaluates numeric float 0.0 as boolean False. When cagr_overall == 0.0, the OR expression falls back to rolling_1y_mean (None in F.16 snapshot), incorrectly setting raw Return to None and data_available to False.
